about: A PROPOSAL from the S7 area agent (round 2 Run 2, 2026-10-12) for the tree factory's trees/assign/S7.json, which the factory owns: S7's nine trees on the existing cards (trees/cards.json), from the needs list (gen/expand/city_end_needs.md, Trees) and the catalogue (gen/expand/round2/catalogue.md, 5). Not checked with tools/tree_cards.mjs check (it reads trees/assign only). Two cards the catalogue orders for S7 don't exist yet: willow_weep_1 (the hanging willow at the cut edge) and bamboo_6 (the two needle trees); until they land, the interim cards below. Without trees/assign/S7.json the page draws all nine on the default willow card (QA, 2026-10-12). Bases and moves come from layout.json (two bushes moved 0.9 m south, build_choices.json).

S7.tree.willow_edge_855.why: the old willow at the cut edge, 11.5 m, gnarled lumpy trunk, bare whips hanging in curtains, a long limb arching east over the gate hall (needs list: the new form willow_weep; catalogue 5, willow_weep_1)

S7.tree.bare_knobbed_905.why: bare gnarled tree leaning west with knobbed crab-claw twig ends over the street's west end, 5.3 m (needs list: elm_claw _1 or _3)

S7.tree.gnarled_low_edge_875.why: conf low: a low knotted mossy trunk with dotted crooked limbs at the cut edge (or a rock); the 4 m elm card (needs list: _4)

S7.tree.bare_bottom_1117.why: big bare tree along the bottom edge, one trunk forking into a broad dome of fine twigs, 6.3 m tall and 7.5 m wide: the wide shoot-tree card (needs list: a larger card or _1 scaled)

S7.tree.shoots_bottom_west_960.why: a dome of fine upright bare shoots with no trunk drawn, 2.5 m tall, 3.6 m wide; 2.1 m from bare_bottom_1117, so another card (needs list: _2, the coppice fan)

S7.tree.twig_bush_bottom_1468.why: a fan of long thin shoots rising from below the bottom edge, 1.6 m (needs list: whip_clump _1)

S7.tree.twig_bush_bottom_1648.why: the smaller fan of shoots, 0.9 m; 2.2 m from twig_bush_bottom_1468, so the other card

S7.tree.needle_tree_1910.why: needle-leaved crown with a pointed top, 2.3 m, the west end of S6's bamboo grove (catalogue 5: bamboo_6; S6's needle_tree_2025 is bamboo_1)

S7.tree.needle_tree_1955.why: one straight culm with 个 sprays, 2.6 m (catalogue 5: bamboo_6, modelled on this tree, crop [1910, 35, 2005, 278]); 0.8 m from needle_tree_1910, so its interim card differs
